svg.text: CustC traffic from Core1 to Core2 across the Inter-AS Option A link
Labels from Core1's traceroute to 10.30.0.2; 1815 and the forwarding at A-ASBR from its BGP, CEF and MPLS forwarding entries for 10.30.0.2;
AS paths from A-ASBR's BGP entry and Core1's IPv6 BGP table. Interface names from the baseline and stage configs.
Core2's route, 10.30.0.2/32, advertised from right to left
eBGP in VRF CustC, no label,
LDP LSP to 10.1.0.8: 1407, popped at A-P4
SR LSP to 10.2.0.5: 16500, popped at B-P2
Each stack is the packet on that link, outermost header on top. Blue boxes: the routers with VRF CustC.
